name: INC-2291 post-incident review — double charges on checkout retry
turns: INC-2291 summary: on 2026-09-28, 37 customers were charged twice. Checkout retried POST /payments after a timeout and generated a new Idempotency-Key for the retry, so the ledger treated it as a new payment.
Confirmed on the checkout side. The retry helper in checkout-api created a fresh key per attempt. Fix is merged: a retry now reuses the key of the first attempt, and we retry at most twice.
Decision for the ledger: from 2026-10-06 every POST to ledger-service must carry an Idempotency-Key header, and requests without one are rejected with HTTP 428. Keys stay valid for 72 hours.
I will add the 428 check and a contract test so a client that forgets the header fails in CI, not in production.
Good. Refunds for the 37 customers went out on 2026-09-29. Action item closed once the contract test is merged.
pinned: Every POST to ledger-service must carry an Idempotency-Key header; a retry must reuse the key of the first attempt. Keys are kept for 72 hours (decided in the INC-2291 review on 2026-09-30).
